title: caroxylon apterygeum
intro: Caroxylon apterygeum, commonly known as the Karkade or Egyptian hibiscus, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Mallow family. The health benefits of Caroxylon apterygeum include its ability to act as a natural diuretic, lower cholesterol levels, and help manage blood pressure due to its high content of antioxidants and vitamins. Therapeutically, it has been used to treat various conditions such as anemia, digestive issues, and as a natural remedy for menstrual disorders. The bioactive constituents of Caroxylon apterygeum include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and antioxidant activity.
